briefing.text: On News, Information Technology stays first (buzz 87.3, -0.2 on the day, +0.8 on the week, mentions -3%, sentiment 0.13) led by NVDA, MSFT and AMD; Financials rose to 6th (buzz 82.2, +1.7) on BAC, UBS and MS, and Energy gained 1.3 on XOM and CVX. On X, IT is also first (buzz 93.4, flat) with NVDA and ANT; Financials moved from 4th to 2nd (mentions +15%, PANW, SOFI, HOOD), and Healthcare buzz fell 13.2 with mentions down 67%. On Reddit, Communication Services holds 3rd with mentions up 35% (GOOGL, META, NFLX), while Energy buzz slipped 1.4 even as mentions rose 51% (BP, OKLO). Real Estate news buzz is down 2.5 over the week (mentions -18% on the day).

KLAR #2: Klarna-Adyen agentic AI checkout deal alongside a shareholder-investigation notice; 8 of 14 articles negative, so it fits the high attention.
BUD #3: dividend analysis and a Moderate Buy consensus; routine news, does not explain the rank.
WSM #4: Citigroup cut its price target to $245 (neutral); 52 articles, 23 negative, and the stock is down 17% in 5 days, so news explains the attention.
GOLD #5: coverage ties it to Asia's AI selloff and whether gold protects when stocks fall; fits the rise from #7.
SILVER #1: same selloff story from Benzinga (positive tone) plus a long-range price prediction piece; supports but is not decisive.
ZM #6: earnings due 11-23 (Hewlett Packard Enterprise and others report Friday); catalyst explains attention.
MSTR #8: new 1-year low as crypto-linked stocks sell off; the stock is down 9.7% on the day, which explains the climb from #14.
SPX #11: broke below 7,000 to a 7-month low; explains the rank.

Silver ranks 1st (up from 4th) mainly on attention: Reddit and X attention are about at or above normal (1.01 and 1.06, in the 96th percentile), with price moving 1.9 sigmas (-4.8% on the day) despite below-normal volume (0.54). Klarna holds 2nd on higher attention (1.11) and X attention (1.39, 98th percentile) plus open interest 1.33 times normal, though volume is below normal (0.49); it also has a KPI market resolving. AB InBev jumped from 8th to 3rd on X attention (0.96) and volume 1.08 times normal, while its Reddit attention is lower (0.69). Attention and X attention carry 35% weight each in the score, which is why these names lead despite modest volume.

notes: Ranks are by the scoring of record (pick_rank, w2). Prices and moves as of the last pull of the day. Facts from public data; not investment advice.
